name: mix_reas_agent_s20261014
description: reasoning (math competition / StackExchange / science) + multi-turn customer-service conversations
validation: 300 single-turn prompts shared by every list (ranks val_ranks)
rule: Two domain lists, all their training rows, each in its own order, interleaved by the packed tokens a prompt of each list takes on average during training (row i of a list placed at (i + 0.5) x its cost), so every prefix holds about half the packed tokens of each domain; once the shorter list ends, only the other follows. Columns: the union of both lists plus `domain` and `src_rank`.
